description: Screenshot of a public page taken by a real headless Chromium after JavaScript runs, returned as a base64 JPEG or PNG with final URL, HTTP status and title. Viewport from 320x240 to 1920x2000, optional full-page capture and extra settle time. For visual checks, layout QA, archiving and vision-model input. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

full_page.description: true to capture the whole scrollable page (default false)

wait_ms.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after load, 0-8000 (default 500)
